constraints.description: Three-Layer Gate Architecture: every quality gate must implement three layers — Layer 1 deterministic checks (field existence, type validation, acyclic dependencies via code), Layer 2 LLM semantic checks (semantic reasonableness, principle alignment, quality assessment), Layer 3 combined decision (merge L1+L2 into PASS/CONDITIONAL/FAIL)
constraints.rationale: Risk R3 (子Agent返回结果质量低但主Loop误判为通过) is high-severity. Code-only gates cannot detect semantic quality issues. LLM-only gates are unreliable for structural checks. The three-layer architecture ensures both structural integrity AND semantic correctness, which is the core defense against cascading low-quality outputs through the fractal Loop. This directly addresses Gate B CRITICAL check 'Quality Gate Architecture'.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: each quality gate definition must explicitly specify which checks belong to Layer 1 (code) vs Layer 2 (LLM). Verify no gate has only Layer 1 without Layer 2. Verify combined decision logic exists at each gate.

constraints.description: Direction Drift Detection at Critical Nodes: the system must implement LLM-driven direction drift detection at every Loop stage transition (Project→Domain, Domain→Phase, Phase completion). Detection must be autonomous (never stop to ask user), use semantic comparison against original goal, and trigger self-correction when drift is detected.
constraints.rationale: User explicit directive: '不希望停下来判断，大模型主动纠错，实时保持主线'. This is REQ-004, REQ-007, REQ-021. Without autonomous drift detection, the system violates the fundamental user requirement for 8h+ unattended operation. This directly addresses Gate B CRITICAL check 'Autonomous Self-Correction Mechanism'.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify drift detection mechanism is specified at each Loop layer transition. Verify detection uses LLM semantic comparison (not hardcoded rules). Verify correction is automatic and logged. Verify system never pauses to ask user for direction confirmation.

constraints.description: Sub-Agent Output Quality Validation via LLM-as-Judge: every sub-Agent output must pass through LLM-as-Judge semantic validation before being accepted by parent Loop. Judge must use independent perspective (different from executor). Judge must evaluate: output completeness, alignment with task requirements, quality sufficiency for downstream consumption.
constraints.rationale: Risk R3 (子Agent返回结果质量低但主Loop误判为通过) is high-severity/medium-likelihood. The fractal Loop architecture means low-quality sub-Agent outputs cascade upward. LLM-as-Judge with independent perspective prevents the 'athlete=referee' blind spot. This is essential for achieving REQ-037 (交付质量: 最终结果质量高).
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify every sub-Agent output has a corresponding LLM-as-Judge validation step. Verify Judge prompt uses independent perspective (not same prompt as executor). Verify validation criteria include completeness, alignment, quality. Verify failed validation triggers retry/switch/escalate per failure recovery decision tree.

constraints.description: Gate Placement at All Critical Loop Stage Transitions: quality gates must exist at (1) Project Loop entry (Gate A: 方案准入), (2) Domain Loop entry/exit, (3) Phase Loop completion, (4) sub-Agent spawn acceptance, (5) Dream Loop self-modification validation. No critical transition can proceed without passing its gate.
constraints.rationale: REQ-002 and REQ-020 mandate quality validation at critical nodes. The fractal Loop has multiple transition points where errors can propagate. Missing gates at any transition creates a quality blind spot. Gate A (方案准入) uses the Meta-Planner weights (completeness 0.25, necessity 0.20, alignment 0.30, global_impact 0.25). Gate B (动态检查) provides continuous lightweight validation.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: map all Loop stage transitions. Verify each transition has a defined quality gate. Verify Gate A exists at Project Loop entry with multi-dimensional scoring. Verify Gate B exists at Domain/Phase transitions. Verify Dream Loop self-modifications have validation gate (Zone 0 check).

constraints.description: Multi-Engine Iteration Quality Progression: the quality system must enforce DeepFlow pipeline-level quality (多引擎迭代+多轮Review), not single-Agent output. This means: (1) multiple independent perspectives (minimum 2) for judgment tasks, (2) iterative refinement cycles (not single-pass), (3) quality progression evidence (each iteration shows measurable improvement or explicit rationale for plateau).
constraints.rationale: REQ-019 explicitly mandates '达到DeepFlow管线级别（多引擎迭代+多轮Review），非单次Agent输出'. Single-pass LLM output has cognitive blind spots (athlete=referee). Multi-engine iteration with independent perspectives is the core mechanism for achieving high delivery quality. This is what distinguishes the framework from naive Agent loops.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify critical tasks use multiple independent perspectives (not single Agent). Verify iterative refinement cycles exist (not single-pass). Verify quality progression is tracked (each iteration's output compared to previous). Verify 'three臭皮匠顶个诸葛亮' principle is implemented via sessions_spawn for parallel independent analysis.

constraints.description: Gate A (方案准入) Multi-Dimensional Scoring: Gate A must evaluate solutions across four dimensions with Meta-Planner weights: completeness (0.25), necessity (0.20), alignment (0.30), global_impact (0.25). Each dimension must have explicit evaluation criteria. Minimum pass rate is 0.88 (7/8 Gate B checks must pass). All CRITICAL Gate B checks (6/6) must pass.
constraints.rationale: Meta-Planner Gate A defines these weights for critical-complexity framework tasks. Alignment (0.30) is highest because the solution must follow 8 core decisions (D1-D8), 6 Zone 0 guardrails, and architectural constraints. Global impact (0.25) is elevated because this framework becomes the foundation for all future autonomous Agent work. The 0.88 threshold ensures near-complete coverage while allowing one MINOR check to be conditional.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify Gate A scoring uses the four dimensions with correct weights. Verify each dimension has explicit evaluation criteria. Verify minimum pass rate (0.88) is enforced. Verify CRITICAL checks (6/6) are mandatory. Verify scoring is LLM-driven (not hardcoded).

constraints.description: Gate B (动态检查) Lightweight Continuous Validation: Gate B must provide continuous lightweight validation at each Loop heartbeat (fast_pulse 3min, slow_pulse 1h). Gate B checks must be fast (< 2s for deterministic, < 10s for LLM semantic). Gate B must not block auto-correction — if drift is detected, correction proceeds immediately, Gate B logs the event.
constraints.rationale: Gate A is heavyweight (full multi-dimensional scoring). Gate B must be lightweight to avoid slowing down the Loop. The heartbeat system (3min/1h/daily/weekly) provides natural checkpoints for Gate B. Gate B must not become a bottleneck — its purpose is continuous monitoring, not exhaustive validation. This balances quality assurance with execution speed.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify Gate B exists at heartbeat intervals. Verify Gate B checks are lightweight (time-bounded). Verify Gate B does not block auto-correction. Verify Gate B logs drift detection events. Verify Gate B triggers Gate A when significant issues are detected.

constraints.description: Quality Gate Non-Blocking for Auto-Correction: quality gates must enable auto-correction, not just pass/fail gating. When a gate detects failure, it must provide: (1) specific failure reason (not just 'failed'), (2) suggested correction direction (LLM-driven), (3) correction execution path (retry/switch/escalate per failure recovery decision tree). Gates must never pause to ask user for correction guidance.
constraints.rationale: User directive: '不停下来等人判断方向是否正确（主动自纠正）'. If gates only provide pass/fail without correction guidance, the system must stop and ask user, violating the core requirement. Gates must be constructive (help system self-correct) not just restrictive (block progress). This aligns with the failure recovery decision tree (timeout→split, test-fail→retry, capability-fail→switch, info-missing→research, direction-wrong→replan).
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify each gate failure path includes specific failure reason. Verify LLM provides correction suggestion. Verify correction execution follows failure recovery decision tree. Verify no gate pauses to ask user for guidance. Verify correction actions are logged for audit.

constraints.description: Direction Guard LLM Prompt Design: direction drift detection must use LLM semantic comparison, not hardcoded rules. The drift detection prompt must include: (1) original goal statement (from living_spec), (2) current task/output being evaluated, (3) explicit instruction to detect semantic drift (not just keyword matching), (4) structured output format (drift_detected: bool, drift_description: str, correction_suggestion: str).
constraints.rationale: Hardcoded drift detection rules cannot adapt to the diverse tasks the Loop will handle. The user explicitly said '检测标准由LLM动态判断，不是硬编码规则'. The drift detection prompt must be designed for semantic understanding, not pattern matching. This is what makes the system truly autonomous vs. a rule-based pipeline.
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify drift detection uses LLM prompt (not regex/hardcoded rules). Verify prompt includes original goal for comparison. Verify prompt requests structured output (drift_detected, description, correction). Verify prompt is designed for semantic understanding (not keyword matching). Verify prompt is stored in Skill/prompt template (not hardcoded in Python).

constraints.description: Meta-Loop Quality Gate Parameter Tuning: the Meta-Loop (weekly) must tune quality gate parameters based on historical performance: (1) Gate A dimension weights (if alignment issues dominate, increase alignment weight), (2) Gate B check frequency (if drift is detected late, increase frequency), (3) LLM-as-Judge prompt refinement (if Judge misses issues, refine prompt), (4) circuit breaker thresholds (if false positives, adjust no-progress threshold).
constraints.rationale: Quality gates are not static — they must adapt based on actual performance. The Meta-Loop's role is to optimize parameters based on historical data. This ensures the quality system improves over time, not just maintains status quo. This aligns with REQ-025 (Dream Loop + Meta-Loop持续自我优化).
constraints.verification_method: Review solution design: verify Meta-Loop includes quality gate parameter tuning. Verify tuning is based on historical performance data (errors.jsonl, drift detection logs). Verify tuning actions are logged to changelog. Verify tuning respects Zone 0 boundaries (cannot weaken safety gates).

analysis_summary:
As Quality Gate & Harness Specialist, my analysis focuses on ensuring the AI Native Loop Engineering Framework achieves DeepFlow pipeline-level quality through multi-engine iteration and multi-round Review, not single-Agent output. The core challenge is balancing comprehensive quality assurance with autonomous operation — gates must be strict enough to prevent cascading failures (Risk R3) but lightweight enough to not block 8h+ unattended operation.

Key architectural decisions:
1. Three-Layer Gate Architecture (deterministic → LLM semantic → combined) ensures both structural and semantic quality.
2. Direction Drift Detection at every Loop stage transition enables autonomous self-correction per user directive.
3. Sub-Agent Output Quality Validation via LLM-as-Judge with independent perspective prevents athlete=referee blind spots.
4. Gate A (方案准入) uses Meta-Planner weights (completeness 0.25, necessity 0.20, alignment 0.30, global_impact 0.25) for heavyweight evaluation.
5. Gate B (动态检查) provides lightweight continuous validation at heartbeat intervals without blocking auto-correction.

Critical risks addressed:
- R3 (子Agent返回结果质量低但主Loop误判为通过): mitigated by LLM-as-Judge with independent perspective.
- R2 (LLM陷入无效循环): detected by Gate B continuous validation + circuit breaker.
- Direction drift: detected by LLM semantic comparison at every transition, corrected autonomously.

The quality system must be constructive (enable auto-correction) not just restrictive (pass/fail gating). This aligns with the core user requirement: '不希望停下来判断，大模型主动纠错，实时保持主线'.
